_comment: Intentionally invalid IEC 61850 mapping examples — for documentation and testing reference only. Each route demonstrates a specific validation error. This file is NOT a valid mapping config and will be rejected by Iec61850MappingConfig.from_dict().

routes._error: INVALID: unrecognized IEC 61850 operation 'GET_DIRECTORY' — only READ, WRITE, SELECT, SELECT_WITH_VALUE, OPERATE, DIRECT_OPERATE, CANCEL, ENABLE_REPORTING, ENABLE_GOOSE, ENABLE_SAMPLED_VALUES, and '*' are accepted
routes.name: bad-operation

routes._error: INVALID: action 'actuate' is not a recognized action verb
routes.name: invalid-action

routes._error: INVALID: resource_type is empty — must be a non-empty string
routes.name: empty-resource-type

routes._error: INVALID: resource_id_template references {value} — values are evidence, never resource identity
routes.name: value-in-template

routes._error: INVALID: resource_id_template references {quality} — quality is evidence, never resource identity
routes.name: quality-in-template

routes._error: INVALID: resource_id_template references {timestamp} and {origin} — protocol state is evidence, never resource identity
routes.name: timestamp-origin-in-template

routes._error: INVALID: malformed template token '{ied_name' — missing closing brace
routes.name: malformed-template

routes._error: INVALID: control route does not reference {data_object} — control commands must identify the controlled data object
routes.name: control-without-data-object

routes._error: INVALID: ENABLE_REPORTING route does not reference {report_control_block} — subscription routes must identify the control block
routes.name: reporting-without-rcb
